title: 2D contour
description: Parameters of a 'contour2d' operation (cam.h Operation::paramsJson, task T-053): the tool runs beside a chain of picked edges (or the loops of picked planar faces) at one or more depths, climb or conventional, with tangent arc or line leads, radial roughing passes, a finish and a spring pass, tabs, and cutter compensation in the computer, in the control or both (wear). The geometry is edges (open or closed chains; tangent edges are followed when 'Follow tangent edges' is on) or planar faces perpendicular to the setup's Z. Heights: 'clearance', 'retract', 'feedPlane' and 'top' are measured from the top of the stock; 'bottom' from the height of each chain (the lowest point of its edges, or the face), so the default bottom 0 cuts down to the picked edges. All five are read. Feeds: the cutting feed along the contour, the plunge feed for plunges and tab moves straight up and down, the ramp feed for ramps, the lead-in and lead-out feeds for the leads. Lengths are millimetres, angles degrees. Annotations for editors: 'x-unit' (length, angle, count), 'x-enumTitles' (labels of an enum, in order), 'x-enumDescriptions' (a detail line for each enum value), 'x-relevantWhen' (the property matters only when every named property has one of the listed values), 'x-propertyOrder' (the order of the form), 'x-heightsUsed' (the members of the operation's heights this type reads, each with what it is measured from), 'x-cuttingUsed' (the members of its cutting data this type reads), 'x-geometry' (what the geometry picker selects: here edges and faces) and 'x-toolTypes' (the tools the picker offers); docs/operation_types.md defines each.

x-geometry.description: Click the edges of the contour (tangent edges are followed), or planar faces to contour their loops (Face loops).

side.title: Tool side
side.description: Which side of the chain the tool runs on. 'auto': away from the material (found by looking at the part beside the chain). 'outside' and 'inside': of a closed chain. 'left' and 'right': seen along the chain, which runs from its end with the lowest X (then Y) for an open chain and counter-clockwise for a closed one.

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: Climb: the tool keeps the material on its right (spindle clockwise). Conventional: on its left.

compensation.title: Compensation
compensation.description: 'computer': the toolpath is the tool centre. 'control': the toolpath is the contour (plus stock to leave) and the control offsets it by the radius in its offset register (G41/G42); the leads need a straight part to switch it on and off. 'wear': the toolpath is the tool centre and G41/G42 is on too, so the register holds only the wear.
x-enumDescriptions: contour path, G41/G42 with the full radius
tool centre path, G41/G42 for wear

followTangent.title: Follow tangent edges
followTangent.description: Continue each open chain through edges of the part that meet its ends tangentially, so one click picks a filleted outline.

faceLoops.title: Face loops
faceLoops.description: For picked faces: which of each face's loops are contoured: its outer boundary, its inner loops (holes), or all.

stockToLeave.title: Stock to leave
stockToLeave.description: Material left on the wall, beside the chain.

stockToLeaveAxial.title: Floor stock to leave
stockToLeaveAxial.description: The bottom is raised by this much.

maxStepdown.title: Maximum stepdown
maxStepdown.description: The deepest cut of one depth: the depths from the top to the bottom are equal steps of at most this; 0: one depth, at the bottom.

roughPasses.title: Roughing passes
roughPasses.description: Passes beside each other at every depth, from the outermost in, 'Roughing stepover' apart.

roughStepover.title: Roughing stepover
roughStepover.description: The distance between roughing passes (with more than one).

finishPass.title: Finish pass
finishPass.description: After the roughing at every depth, one pass at the full depth that removes the finish allowance.

finishAllowance.title: Finish allowance
finishAllowance.description: What the roughing leaves for the finish pass, beside the stock to leave.

springPass.title: Spring pass
springPass.description: The last pass once more at the same place and depth, for the tool's deflection.

leadType.title: Leads
leadType.description: How the tool joins the contour and leaves it, tangentially: an arc (with an optional straight part), a straight line along the contour's tangent, or none (the tool goes down on the contour).

leadRadius.title: Lead radius
leadRadius.description: Of the lead arc's tool-centre path; 0: the tool's diameter. Made smaller (down to a quarter) where it does not fit; with compensation in the control it stays larger than the tool radius.

leadSweep.title: Lead sweep
leadSweep.description: The angle the lead arc turns through.

leadLength.title: Lead straight length
leadLength.description: Arc leads: a straight part before the lead-in arc and after the lead-out arc (needed with compensation in the control or wear, where it switches G41/G42 on and off). Line leads: the line's length; 0: the tool's diameter.

rampAngle.title: Ramp angle
rampAngle.description: Where the tool must enter material at a depth (not from outside the stock nor through area cut already), it ramps down along the lead-in or the contour at most this steeply; 0: no ramps (only a tool that cuts at its centre may then go straight down). Also the slope of the tool's way back down after a rectangular tab when it does not cut at its centre.

tabs.title: Tabs
tabs.description: Leave tabs (bridges) holding the part: at the depths below the tab height the tool rises over each tab.

tabShape.title: Tab shape
tabShape.description: Rectangular: the tool goes straight up and over. Triangular: up and down at a slope, the tab a triangle as wide as 'Tab width' at its foot.

tabCount.title: Tab count
tabCount.description: Tabs per chain, spread evenly along it.

tabWidth.title: Tab width
tabWidth.description: The material each tab keeps, along the tool-centre path (at its foot for a triangular tab).

tabHeight.title: Tab height
tabHeight.description: The height of the tabs above the bottom.
